name: Exp_ttm-trend_ReOpen
summary: This EA implements the TTM Trend indicator strategy, a trend-following system based on price momentum and color-bar analysis. It enters trades in the direction of the identified trend and features a ReOpen mechanism that allows re-entering positions after a prior trade is closed, capturing extended trend moves. The EA systematically opens and manages positions based on the TTM Trend signal logic.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了TTM Trend指标策略，一种基于价格动量和彩色K线分析的趋势跟踪系统。它在识别到的趋势方向上入场交易，并具有ReOpen（重新开仓）机制，允许在先前交易平仓后重新进入头寸，以捕获延长的趋势走势。该EA基于TTM Trend信号逻辑系统地开仓和管理头寸。
strategy_analysis: 该EA基于TTM Trend指标进行趋势跟踪交易，TTM Trend是一种通过计算价格相对于其移动平均线的位置来确定趋势方向的指标，通常以彩色K线（红/绿或红/蓝）显示趋势状态。入场条件为当TTM Trend指标确认趋势方向转变或延续时开仓，ReOpen机制意味着在一次顺势交易平仓后，如果趋势信号仍然有效，EA会重新开仓以继续跟随趋势。出场条件可能包括固定止盈止损、趋势反转信号或指标颜色变化。仓位管理方面，EA允许设置固定手数或基于资金比例的仓位计算。资金管理上，该EA依赖参数化的止损止盈设置，但ReOpen机制可能导致在趋势末期频繁重复开仓从而增加风险敞口。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA trades based on the TTM Trend indicator, which determines trend direction by calculating price position relative to its moving average, typically displayed as colored bars (red/green or red/blue) indicating trend state. Entry conditions trigger when the TTM Trend indicator confirms a trend direction change or continuation, opening positions in the prevailing trend direction. The ReOpen mechanism allows the EA to re-enter positions after a prior trade closes, provided the trend signal remains valid, enabling capture of extended trend moves. Exit conditions likely include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, trend reversal signals, or indicator color changes. Position sizing supports fixed lot sizes or equity-proportional calculation. Money management relies on parameterized stop-loss and take-profit settings, but the ReOpen mechanism can lead to frequent re-entries near trend exhaustion, potentially increasing risk exposure.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, limits max loss per trade

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, locks profit target per trade

parameters.name: ReOpen
parameters.description: 是否允许趋势延续时重新开仓
parameters.description_en: Allow re-entry to add position in same direction

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于区分不同实例的订单
parameters.description_en: Magic number for closing, 0 for all positions

parameters.name: Timeframe
parameters.description_en: RSI timeframe, 0 for current chart period

pros: 趋势跟踪策略逻辑清晰，顺势交易符合趋势市场的基本原则
ReOpen机制能够在趋势延续期间持续获利，避免过早离场错过大行情
基于TTM Trend指标的系统化信号减少了主观判断的干扰
参数化设计允许用户根据不同品种和市场条件灵活调整
pros_en: Clear trend-following logic that aligns with the fundamental principle of trading with the trend
ReOpen mechanism captures extended trend moves, avoiding premature exits that miss large profitable runs
Systematic signal generation based on TTM Trend indicator reduces subjective judgment interference
Parameterized design allows flexible adjustment for different instruments and market conditions
cons: ReOpen机制在趋势末期可能导致频繁反复开仓，增加亏损风险
震荡行情中趋势跟踪策略容易产生连续假信号导致多次止损
缺乏明确的资金管理策略，如根据波动率动态调整仓位或止损
依赖单一指标信号，没有多维度确认机制来过滤假突破
未考虑点差和滑点对短线交易的实际影响
cons_en: ReOpen mechanism can cause frequent re-entries near trend exhaustion, increasing loss risk
Trend-following strategies generate consecutive false signals in ranging markets, leading to multiple stop-outs
Lacks dynamic money management such as volatility-based position sizing or adaptive stop-loss
Relies on a single indicator signal without multi-dimensional confirmation to filter false breakouts
Does not account for spread and slippage impact on short-term trade profitability
improvements: 增加多时间框架确认机制，如更高周期趋势方向一致时才允许开仓，减少假信号
引入基于ATR的动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自适应调整，替代固定点数设置
为ReOpen机制增加最大重开次数限制和趋势强度过滤，防止在趋势衰竭时反复入场
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation, requiring higher timeframe trend alignment before entry to reduce false signals
Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit that adapt to market volatility instead of fixed pip values
Add maximum re-entry count and trend strength filtering for the ReOpen mechanism to prevent repeated entries during trend exhaustion

risk_points: ReOpen机制可能在趋势反转时导致连续亏损开仓
缺乏波动率自适应止损，固定止损在高波动市场可能过小
单一指标依赖缺乏冗余确认，假信号风险较高
未明确检测是否已有同方向持仓，可能造成过度集中
risk_points_en: ReOpen mechanism may cause consecutive losing entries during trend reversals
Fixed stop-loss without volatility adaptation may be too tight in high-volatility markets
Single-indicator reliance lacks redundancy confirmation, increasing false signal risk
No explicit check for existing same-direction positions may lead to over-concentration
